entities.summary: The Canes II Group or Canes Venatici II Group is a group of galaxies about 26.1 million light-years away from Earth. The group resides in the Local Supercluster. The largest galaxy within the cluster is M106, which is a barred spiral galaxy. Canes II Group is a galaxy group. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
